messages:
maya: FYI scheduling a config-only canary tonight 01:45 UTC. No model change. Goal: reduce spike p95 for short prompts and avoid increased cost from tiny-batch churn.

maya: Proposed changes:
routing.policy: adaptive-weight
routing.weights.short_path: 0.14 -> 0.22
batching.max_batch_size: 64 -> 80
batching.batch_timeout_ms: 500 -> 360
queue.max_inflight: 200 -> 160

andre: ack. I'll prepare a small probe that mimics short prompt shape and add a grafana panel.

sophie: Exclude perf-load and chaos tenants again, they skew batch size distribution.

maya: added tenant_exclude: ["perf-load","chaos"] and rollout_tag=7321998888. Also disabling autotuner during the window.

andre: rollback rules proposal: auto-rollback if 5xx increases by >=0.7% absolute for 3m OR p95 regresses by >150ms sustained 5m. Immediate rollback if kv_evictions >20% OR queue_depth >30%.

maya: adding to deploy config. ops rollback command: `/deploybot rollback 7321998888` pinned in #eng-releases.

deploy-bot: @channel Deploy started: config-only canary id=7321998888 by maya -> service=inference-prod, canary=4%. See /deploys/7321998888

deploy-bot: Canary step applied at 01:45:12 UTC.

oncall-bot: Oncall alerted: watching kv_evictions, p95, 5xx, queue_depth.

andre: dashboard link: https://grafana.company/d/rollouts/7321998888 (probe, p95, 5xx, kv_evictions). Refresh 30s.

deploy-bot: Health @ +8m: p95 37ms (baseline 35ms), 5xx 0.05%, kv_evictions +3%, queue_depth +5% -> within thresholds.

sophie: enterprise-legacy tenant needs pin for 45m per preflight. Applying pin now.

maya: acknowledged. Proceeding to ramp to 20% after 20m hold if still green.

deploy-bot: Ramp executed at 02:10:04 UTC -> 20% traffic.

oncall-bot: Note: small uptick in kv_evictions at +12m -> +11% from baseline. Not critical yet.

andrew: small-probe median latency improved ~9% for tiny prompts. Cost probe looks favorable.

maya: keeping the hold at 20% for 90m due to eviction trend. If evictions hit 16% we page; 20% -> auto rollback.

sophie: adding to release notes: "Config-only: increased short-path routing weight, larger max batch to reduce cost per token, shortened batch timeout to improve p95. Enterprise-legacy pinned for 45m."

maya: good. locking thread for now; reopen on threshold or customer feedback. Thanks. :thumbsup:
